title: Baked Feta Chicken & Sweet Potato Tray Bake
description: Sweet potato, broccoli, chickpeas and feta roasted on one tray, with chicken added part-way through. Good for meal prep.

confidence.note: Amounts are from the creator's caption. The caption's method doesn't say when the chickpeas and olive oil go in; adding them with the vegetables is an assumption. Not yet cooked and confirmed at home.

nutrition.note: As stated by the source (fibre estimated by the source); not independently checked.

items.item: salt, garlic granules, mixed herbs and pepper

steps.title: Load the tray
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Add the sweet potato ({{sweet-potato}}), broccoli ({{broccoli}}), onion ({{onion}}), chickpeas ({{chickpeas}}) and crumbled feta ({{feta}}) to a baking tray. Drizzle with the oil ({{oil}}) and season well with salt, garlic granules, mixed herbs and pepper.

steps.title: Add chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken ({{chicken}}) to the tray and cook until cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight from the tray, or divide into containers for meal prep.

notes.title: Worth watching
notes.text: The broccoli spends 50–55 minutes at 200°C in this method, which may char it. If it browns too fast, add it with the chicken instead.
